concept: Intentional time and rest during Ramadan
brief: An elegant single champagne-gold crescent embracing a compact hourglass with a deep-indigo frame and warm ivory sand. The hourglass is clearly recognizable with two balanced chambers, connecting productivity windows and intentional rest during Ramadan. Strong simple integrated silhouette, no schedule bars from the previous design. Midnight indigo #131F4D, gold #D0B87C and ivory #FFE8B0. No stars, sunburst, mosque, clock face, calendar tile, fake religious seal or countdown numerals.
